item.title: Re: The Blood Prince
item.content:encoded:
Thank you for the crit

And I promise that I will work on editing my SCP as soon. But I will say/answer a few things regarding my SCP.

Now I'm thinking of Star-Lord, at least in the movies.

That may be true, But the scenario is quite different. His Biological Mother was raped by his Biological Father and left after it was committed. A few months later, The mother confirmed that she was pregnant and decided to keep the child rather than get rid of it.

Try to give your character some type of obstacle.

As a matter of fact, I did think of something like that. But I will add it when I start editing my SCP.

How did they know he was the one who did it? Why did he kill those children?

Why? It's because the SCP was a bit of an anti-socialist and there were multiple occasions that his bullies would take advantage of it when given the chance. Eventually, he just had enough of it. He subconsciously activates his power and killed his bullies out of hatred.

How? Well, The Place where he murdered his bullies was at some park and there were a few people who have witnessed the entire event.

I think you're giving him too many powers

Sorry, That's a mistake I didn't notice sooner. He only has one power and it's just his eyes. As for that Healing Factor, I'll remove it soon.

As for the rest of the details. I will work on re-editing it soon.

Once again. Thank you for the crit

item.title: Re: The Blood Prince
item.content:encoded:
Here, have a Placeholder. I'll crit this within 24 hours.

Let's see what we have here.

[+] Here, have some crit
[-] OK, now give me back my crit

SCP - XXXX, labeled as 'The Blood Prince'

Don't call the anomaly other than its designation. The "titles" that are seen in the Series Lists are not in-universe.

Should anything or anyone get caught in his line of sight, they become completely immobilized until they are either out of the line of sight of the SCP, or he willingly releases them.

This seems very vague. Like, this would need to be voluntary for it to work, and that will make this concept to fall into the 'X-Men Syndrome'. Also, why it is a Keter? You say that it can kill people, but you didn't say anything about metal and other hard-to-destroy materials. They could just use some metal-like material to cover his eyes.

by issuing the command towards the host

This makes this concept to fall even further into the 'X-Men Syndrome', as this gives me a sensation of just another superhero story. I feel like this character is just a combination of Xavier and Cyclops.

it revealed that he was born Half-Human while the origin of the Other Half’s origin is unknown

Now I'm thinking of Star-Lord, at least in the movies.

But it did provide the boy a healing factor that allows him to regenerate from any injuries he sustains.

I think this character is also falling into the category of a Mary Sue. A character that doesn't have any disadvantage and success at everything. Try to give your character some type of obstacle.

After the Incident, The Foundation came in and housed him in a standard humanoid containment unit.

How did they know he was the one who did it? Why did he kill those children?

He’s been provided with a blindfold to cover his eyes

If the blindfold is locked to his head, then I think it's good. If he can remove it at well, then it's not good. The Foundation is a prison, not the Xavier Institute.

His Powers can work on almost anything or anyone, even SCPs

I think you're giving him too many powers. This just makes him to fall further into a Mary Sue cliché.

Overall, this concept has way too many superhero clichés. Furthermore, you may want to read this essay about writing humanoid SCPs, and/or the 'Humanoids' tab in the HTWASCP page.

Feel free to contact a member of the Butterfly Squad to get more crit, or PM me to take another look.

item.title: The Blood Prince
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: No (I want to hear other people’s opinions first before I proceed in adding or editing this article for greenlights.)

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP - XXXX, labeled as 'The Blood Prince', is a Keter Class Anomaly due to his superior capability of controlling animate or inanimate objects when his eyes turn red as blood. Should anything or anyone get caught in his line of sight, they become completely immobilized until they are either out of the line of sight of the SCP, or he willingly releases them.

SCP – XXXX is also capable of using his powers to hurt or kill the affected host by issuing the command towards the host and several internal and/or external injuries will inexplicably appear out of the ordinary. (This only occurs if he’s controlling a single host in his line of sight.)

The Blood Prince may appear as some average 10 yr. old boy. But during a thorough medical examination, it revealed that he was born Half-Human while the origin of the Other Half’s origin is unknown. But it did provide the boy a healing factor that allows him to regenerate from any injuries he sustains.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

An Incident occurred involving three elementary boys who were found dead in a nearby playground caused by the SCP’s power. Autopsy shows that all three of them were killed by internal injuries, but the causes of these inflicted injuries are unknown.

After the Incident, The Foundation came in and housed him in a standard humanoid containment unit. To ensure his powers doesn’t come at random, He’s been provided with a blindfold to cover his eyes to avoid any unintentional accidents to Foundation Personnel should they come in eye contact with him.

But despite his supernatural power as well as the events that occurred with it, He only wishes to live a normal life and return to his family rather than spend an entire life in isolation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: His Powers can work on almost anything or anyone, even SCPs are no exceptions to this. Apparently, his powers doesn’t work on dead material such as corpses, withered plants, and even soul-based beings.
